    # Navigate to the Prices tab to set the price
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Prices").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Fill the price field; assuming it's a textbox with name 'Price' or similar
    # Use exact name match to avoid ambiguity
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Price", exact=True).fill("169.99")
    # Navigate to the Inventory tab to set stock quantity
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Inventory").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Fill the quantity field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Quantity", exact=True).fill("42")
    # Save the product
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
